claim: Wrong or missing: "The afternoon A/B's second default run crashed, and its two files conflict."
found: The file conflict is placed on the wrong run. runs.json has no r9-ab-default-2 entry. The conflicting entries are r9-ab-default-1 (runs.json 12.80 s/gen, 142.2 s vs runs-all.json 12.60, 139.2), r9-ab-tail-1 (13.89 vs 12.12) and r9-ab-certain-1 (runs.json exit null, 0 gens vs run.log and runs-all exit 0, 10 gens, 12.07). The Wrong-or-missing box never names these, although the body shows the runs-all values (12.60, 12.12, 12.07) as plain figures. A third value for r9-ab-default-1's warm s/gen, 10.91 in lit/evidence-profile.json, is in neither the box nor the body.
source: runs.json -> ab.default[0] / ab.tail[0] / ab.certain[0]; runs-all.json -> [name=r9-ab-*]; runs/r9-ab-certain-1/run.log (exit 0); lit/evidence-profile.json -> warm_s_per_gen

claim: Occupancy section: "put occupancy at 11.52 s (n = 2) against production's 12.14 s (n = 3)"
found: Two files give different figures for these runs. occ/result.json reports occ-ni-a/b as 11.68 / 11.53 (mean 11.61) and occ-prod-a/b/c as 12.06 / 12.37 / 12.04 (mean 12.16). Those match the mean of genWalls[1:], not warmPerGen. runs-all.json warmPerGen gives 11.62 / 11.43 (mean 11.52) and 12.09 / 12.34 / 11.99 (mean 12.14). The report shows runs-all's figures without noting the conflict. It also gives no spreads (ni 0.18, prod 0.35). Gap 0.61 s/gen, which clears both spreads. That does not fit 'unproven' unless the box says this chain is not a default arm. The verdict stands, because occ-prod is not the default env.

claim: Decision-table rows tail / tail + certain (verdict 'rerun'); "pre-fix tail code", "the one post-fix run"
found: No file in the data says the r9pre runs are pre-fix code or that the tail code was fixed between 11:53 and 14:05 ET. det-r9.txt only says 'round 9 code'. The 'rerun' verdict rests on this unsupported label. Recomputed n=3 A/B: tail 13.63 vs default 12.60 (+1.03, spreads 0.53/0.46), certain 13.20 (+0.59, spread 0.20). Both are slower beyond the spreads. Neither ships in any case, so the ship verdict is unchanged.

claim: Wrong or missing: "Compact state's checkpoints were never diffed against default's." (and the verdict "its results match")
found: This contradicts the source the report cites itself. stack/result.json says all 6 stack chain runs' checkpoints are IDENTICAL to base-a, and base-a is a default run (chain.log stage 1, no env). Only determinism.txt is missing from the fixture. Because the box puts it this way, the verdict ('results match', ships) says the checkpoint condition is met while the box says it is unchecked. The box should say the diff was against base-a, not the ab-base runs, and that determinism.txt is not in the data.

claim: "The one full run on disk, full-tail-1, exited 1 at gen 14 of 40"
found: Not the only full run. runs-all.json also holds r9pre-full-tail (exit 1, 80 of 100 gens, 2633.9 s), r9pre-full-certain (exit 1, 65 gens, 1040.1 s) and r9-full-default (exit 0, 100 gens; the report shows this one under Also measured). The two crashed r9pre full runs are not in Wrong-or-missing. They are not shown as figures either.

claim: "Tail share is the scorer's tailShare field ..., the warm generations' tail bucket divided by their wall (gpu-profile.json)"
found: The stated definition does not reproduce the field. Summing buckets.tail / wall over warm gens in gpu-profile.json gives 0.402 for ab-base-1 and 0.401 for ab-stack-1. tailShare is 0.439 / 0.437. The tailShare values and the means/spreads (44.0% vs 43.2%, 1.5% / 1.1%) are right as read from runs-all.json. Only the definition sentence is unsupported.

claim: Also measured: "Compact state's overnight chain, no interleaved default arm, 11.31 s over n = 4 runs vs production's 11.85 s"
found: No n or spread on the production side (n = 2, stack-prod-a/b, 11.81-11.88) or the compact side (range 0.12). Also, chain.log stages 29-32 alternate stack-prod and stack-c/d, so production was interleaved in part.

claim: Wrong or missing: "Three files disagree on r9-ab-default-1's tail share, 42.0% vs 35.2%"
found: It says three files but gives two values. The third, runs.json's 42.6% (really r9pre-ab-default-1's value), is left out of the box.
